summary: Modularize status_io and harden relative symlink traversal, JSON bounds, control chars, and secret scanning

delivery.outcome: Extract bounded file/JSON I/O and symlink/secret helpers into standard/status_io.py (< 500L), prevent relative sym_dir/.. symlink-parent traversal, bound JSON integer digits before int(), reject ASCII control characters in summary and inline credential material in validate_stream and validate_status_json, enforce optional schema and component name checks, sync profiles/dsl-manifest.json digests, expand standard/test_status_hardening.py, and mark merged ticket-008 DONE.
nonGoals: No breaking changes to valid status streams or status.json documents

architecture.decision: Extract bounded regular-file/JSON I/O and secret material scanning into standard/status_io.py re-exported by standard/status_check.py so every module stays strictly below 500 lines, and sync profiles/dsl-manifest.json artifact digests.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket-009 commit or close the pull request before merge.
